name: Family Trio WGS Germline
overview: 适用于父母-子代 Trio 家系的全基因组种系变异联合检测。基于 GATK Best Practices (v4.5)，覆盖 FASTQ→VCF 全链路，包含联合分型、de novo 检出、遗传模式筛选。
overviewEn: Joint germline variant detection for parent-child trio families using GATK Best Practices (v4.5). Covers the full FASTQ-to-VCF pipeline including joint genotyping, de novo detection, and inheritance pattern filtering.

steps.name: 比对 (BWA-MEM2)
steps.description: 将 Clean Reads 比对到 hg38 参考基因组
steps.descriptionEn: Align Clean Reads to the hg38 reference genome

tools.name: BWA-MEM2
tools.notes: BWA-MEM2 比 BWA-MEM 快约 2×。也可选 DragMap 提速 3-5×。
tools.notesEn: BWA-MEM2 is ~2× faster than BWA-MEM. DragMap option available for 3-5× speedup.

steps.notes: BWA-MEM2 比 BWA-MEM 快约 2×。也可选 DragMap 提速 3-5×。
steps.notesEn: BWA-MEM2 is ~2× faster than BWA-MEM. DragMap option available for 3-5× speedup.

steps.name: 标记重复 + BQSR
steps.description: 标记 PCR 重复并对碱基质量进行重校准
steps.descriptionEn: Mark PCR duplicates and recalibrate base quality scores

tools.name: GATK MarkDuplicates
tools.notes: BQSR 基于 dbSNP/1000G/Mills 等已知位点集。家系分析中不推荐完全移除重复，仅标记即可。
tools.notesEn: BQSR based on dbSNP/1000G/Mills known variant sets. For trio analysis, marking duplicates is preferred over removal.

steps.notes: BQSR 基于 dbSNP/1000G/Mills 等已知位点集。家系分析中不推荐完全移除重复，仅标记即可。
steps.notesEn: BQSR based on dbSNP/1000G/Mills known variant sets. For trio analysis, marking duplicates is preferred over removal.

steps.name: 单样本 GVCF
steps.description: HaplotypeCaller GVCF 模式，每个样本独立生成
steps.descriptionEn: HaplotypeCaller in GVCF mode, one per sample

tools.name: GATK HaplotypeCaller
tools.notes: GVCF 模式便于后续增量联合 calling。Trio 中 3 个样本完全并行。
tools.notesEn: GVCF mode enables incremental joint calling. 3 trio samples run fully in parallel.

steps.notes: GVCF 模式便于后续增量联合 calling。Trio 中 3 个样本完全并行。
steps.notesEn: GVCF mode enables incremental joint calling. 3 trio samples run fully in parallel.

steps.name: GVCF 整合
steps.description: 将 3 个 GVCF 导入 GenomicsDB 数据库

tools.name: GATK GenomicsDBImport
tools.notes: 按染色体区间并行导入。3 个样本的 Trio 直接全基因组导入即可。
tools.notesEn: Parallel import by chromosome interval. For a 3-sample trio, direct genome-wide import suffices.

steps.notes: 按染色体区间并行导入。3 个样本的 Trio 直接全基因组导入即可。
steps.notesEn: Parallel import by chromosome interval. For a 3-sample trio, direct genome-wide import suffices.

steps.name: 联合基因分型
steps.description: 基于 GenomicsDB 进行家系联合分型
steps.descriptionEn: Joint genotyping from GenomicsDB for trio

tools.name: GATK GenotypeGVCFs
tools.notes: 联合分型可利用群体信息提高稀有变异敏感性，并输出一致的基因型矩阵。对 Trio 设计增益明显。
tools.notesEn: Leverages population information to improve rare variant sensitivity and produce a consistent genotype matrix. Significant boost for trio designs.

steps.notes: 联合分型可利用群体信息提高稀有变异敏感性，并输出一致的基因型矩阵。对 Trio 设计增益明显。
steps.notesEn: Leverages population information to improve rare variant sensitivity and produce a consistent genotype matrix. Significant boost for trio designs.

steps.name: VQSR 过滤 / Hard-Filtering
steps.description: 分别对 SNP 和 Indel 进行 VQSR 质量重校准；小样本备选硬过滤
steps.descriptionEn: VQSR recalibration for SNPs and Indels; Hard-Filtering for small cohorts

tools.name: GATK VariantRecalibrator
tools.notes: ⚠ VQSR 至少需要 30 样本才稳健。Trio 小样本建议 Hard-Filtering：QD<2.0, FS>60, MQ<40, SOR>3.0。
tools.notesEn: VQSR requires >=30 samples for robustness. For small trio cohorts, Hard-Filtering recommended: QD<2.0, FS>60, MQ<40, SOR>3.0.

steps.notes: ⚠ VQSR 至少需要 30 样本才稳健。Trio 小样本建议 Hard-Filtering：QD<2.0, FS>60, MQ<40, SOR>3.0。
steps.notesEn: VQSR requires >=30 samples for robustness. For small trio cohorts, Hard-Filtering recommended: QD<2.0, FS>60, MQ<40, SOR>3.0.

steps.name: De Novo 检测
steps.description: 基于 PED 家系文件识别新发变异
steps.descriptionEn: Identify de novo variants using PED pedigree file

tools.name: GATK PossibleDeNovo
tools.notes: 筛选仅先证者存在、父母为参考纯合的变异。结合 gnomAD MAF<0.01 及功能注释进一步缩窄候选。
tools.notesEn: Filter for variants present only in proband, homozygous reference in both parents. Narrow candidates with gnomAD MAF<0.01 and functional annotation.

steps.notes: 筛选仅先证者存在、父母为参考纯合的变异。结合 gnomAD MAF<0.01 及功能注释进一步缩窄候选。
steps.notesEn: Filter for variants present only in proband, homozygous reference in both parents. Narrow candidates with gnomAD MAF<0.01 and functional annotation.

steps.name: 家系遗传模式筛选
steps.description: 按 AD/AR/X-linked 等遗传模式 + 表型过滤候选基因
steps.descriptionEn: Filter by AD/AR/X-linked inheritance patterns plus phenotype

tools.name: slivar
tools.notes: slivar 一站式支持 de novo、compound het、AR homozygous、AD inherited 等模式。结合表型 HPO 词条效果更佳。
tools.notesEn: slivar provides one-stop support for de novo, compound het, AR homozygous, AD inherited patterns. Combine with HPO terms for better results.

steps.notes: slivar 一站式支持 de novo、compound het、AR homozygous、AD inherited 等模式。结合表型 HPO 词条效果更佳。
steps.notesEn: slivar provides one-stop support for de novo, compound het, AR homozygous, AD inherited patterns. Combine with HPO terms for better results.

steps.name: 变异注释 + QC 报告
steps.description: 功能注释 + MultiQC 汇总

tools.name: Ensembl VEP
tools.notes: VEP 输出含 gnomAD AF、ClinVar 临床意义、CADD/SIFT/PolyPhen 预测分数。MultiQC 汇总覆盖度、Ti/Tv、比对率等。
tools.notesEn: VEP output includes gnomAD AF, ClinVar significance, CADD/SIFT/PolyPhen scores. MultiQC summarizes coverage, Ti/Tv ratio, alignment rate, etc.

steps.notes: VEP 输出含 gnomAD AF、ClinVar 临床意义、CADD/SIFT/PolyPhen 预测分数。MultiQC 汇总覆盖度、Ti/Tv、比对率等。
steps.notesEn: VEP output includes gnomAD AF, ClinVar significance, CADD/SIFT/PolyPhen scores. MultiQC summarizes coverage, Ti/Tv ratio, alignment rate, etc.
